method: Visual transcription of the source images, with upstream region annotations available as provenance. No Lettra or other OCR output was used. Actual printed case, spelling, quantities and amounts are retained; rows are read left-to-right, then top-to-bottom.
conventions: Whitespace between columns is represented by one space. Decorative rules, dot leaders, checkmarks, staple marks and punched holes are not text and are omitted.
Printed text inserted above the receipt by the dataset is included when visible. No handwritten text overlapping printed content is accepted.

Two original full-page scans have a fixed rectangular crop that excludes only exterior handwritten dataset IDs and blank paper. All printed receipt text is retained. Source JPEGs and crop geometry are preserved.

These are single-reviewer visual references, not independently double-annotated gold labels. Specific difficult glyphs are documented per receipt; scores should not imply precision beyond this reference quality.

selection.eligibility: English/Latin-script printed main receipt, no unknown annotation regions in the main receipt and no handwritten text over printed receipt content. Exterior handwritten dataset IDs may be removed by a documented rectangular crop before any OCR scoring.

replacements.reason: 000 includes Chinese lines recorded as unknown *** and handwritten text; 001 is the next eligible source.

selection.additionalCandidateOutcome: All had handwritten dataset IDs; 294 also contains Chinese text, 440 has damaged footer text, and 442/443 include other documents. None was scored. Original 292/438 retained with documented crops after allowing removal of exterior dataset IDs.

notes: The blue checkmark is omitted. Duplicate footer annotations in the upstream CSV are not repeated.

Small faded glyphs in GF-TABLE LAMP/STITCH <i> and the M026588 member identifier are the reviewer's best visual reading; these are reference uncertainties. The printed word STITCH is retained rather than changed to SWITCH.

Green checkmarks are omitted. The final enquiry line is vertically clipped in the source; the readable text is included, with the final semicolon supported by the upstream annotation. Address punctuation is small and slightly blurred.
The printed date is 27/03/2018 and the printed tax code is SR @ A; the latter is not rewritten as a tax percentage.
